episodes.synopsis: Yoshika leaps back into action to save her friend's father, but her striker unit almost blows up on the tarmac!
episodes.title: The Magical Girl of the Alps

episodes.synopsis: When a Neuroi strikes at Europe's biggest supply port on the eve of humanity's counterattack, Yoshika must hold it off alone, without any weapons at all!
episodes.title: The Strike Witches Come Together

episodes.synopsis: Yoshika's lost control of her magic… again! It's time for more training and more hard work if she wants to get it back!
episodes.title: What the Two of Us Can Do

episodes.synopsis: Shirley's world record was just broken, and she's not happy about it. As Shirley and Lucchini attempt to beat the new world record, an unusual Neuroi threat swiftly approaches.
episodes.title: Beyond Two Hundred Miles Per Hour

episodes.synopsis: The girls take a detour to Nederland, to help a legendary flower bloom.
episodes.title: Queen of Nederland

episodes.synopsis: When Erica is shot down in enemy territory, Gertrud will do whatever it takes to get her back.
episodes.title: Hounds of Vengeance

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious idol causes all the witches' breasts to grow bigger and bigger, and the girls gradually fall victim one by one...
episodes.title: They Go Boing-Boing

episodes.synopsis: Rocket attacks from the Neuroi nest in Berlin are threatening the base in Kiel. Only Mina has what it takes to stop them, but her magic power is fading…
episodes.title: Mina's Sky

episodes.synopsis: Operation Southwind begins with a full-scale air assault on Berlin. When Yoshika is ordered to stay behind to conserve her magic, Shizuka steps up to try and fill the hole.
episodes.title: Shizuka, Come In!

episodes.synopsis: With Miyafuji's magic power disabled, humanity is forced to use its backup plan: the powerful Ratte tank. But can they win without their ultimate ace?
episodes.title: Road to Berlin

episodes.synopsis: Yoshika is trapped inside the dome around Berlin, and the rest of the Witches are cut off. Can they get inside to save her in time?
episodes.title: I Still Want to Protect
